equipment_type: Split air conditioner BACnet gateway (1 indoor unit)
applies_to: Samsung NASA-protocol indoor units, connected on the F3/F4 remote-controller bus (one unit or a group acting as one).
summary: Intesis interface for one Samsung NASA indoor unit (or a group of units that act as one) on the F3/F4 bus, with BACnet MS/TP or Modbus RTU selected on a DIP switch. It exposes 41 fixed objects: on/off, mode, setpoint, fan and vane commands with matching status objects, error and filter signals, WindFree and air-clean modes, Cassette 360 airflow and a dual-setpoint (DSP) function.
notes: The manual's object table has no read/write column. Access here is inferred: AO/BO/MO command objects as commandable, AV/BV as writable (except IU_Pos_status_reported, which only reports), inputs as read-only.
Binary objects are listed in the manual with values 1 and 2 (for example 1: Off, 2: On); they are kept as printed.
Footnote numbers printed after some object names in the table (for example Mode_status2) are not part of the name and were removed.
WindFree, air-clean and Cassette 360 airflow objects only apply to indoor units with those features; on Cassette 360 units the up/down airflow uses the 360_CST objects instead of AirDirectionUD.
Temperature objects follow the °C/°F setting on DIP switch SW2 position 8.

source.title: IN485SAM001R000 User Manual - Samsung NASA Systems to BACnet MS/TP and Modbus RTU

integration.summary: Wire the gateway to the Samsung F3/F4 bus, leave SW1 position 5 OFF for BACnet MS/TP, set the MAC address on SW2, then write the _command objects and read back the _status objects. Several indoor units on one gateway behave as one unit.

minimum_points.name: SetPoint_status
minimum_points.why: Setpoint the unit is really using

integration.enable: No enable point is documented. BV 2 LockRemoteControl can lock the wired remote.
integration.remote_sensors: To use a BMS room sensor, write its value to AO 1 RoomTemperature_command; the unit then uses it as its reference temperature. Only write it when a BMS sensor is meant to replace the unit's own reading, and write 0x8000 to stop using it.
setup: SW1 position 5 OFF = BACnet MS/TP (default), ON = Modbus RTU.
Baud rate on SW1; autobaud is the default and follows other MS/TP devices on the bus.
Default device instance 246000; in automatic mode it is 246000 + the MAC address set on SW2. Writing Object_Identifier switches to manual addressing until a factory reset.
Factory reset: set all SW1 and SW2 switches ON, power-cycle, then set them all OFF within 30 seconds.
gotchas: The gateway cannot tell whether dual setpoint is enabled on the Samsung side. Turn it on from the BMS with BV 5 DualSetpoint_active = 2, then write AO 3 (heat) and AO 4 (cool); also set the wired remote to DSP mode or it shows the average.
In Fan mode the unit keeps a new setpoint but the wired remote may still show the old one until the next write in a temperature mode.
Write the _command object and read the _status object.
